A, B and M all independently generate witnesses, yet unique truth recovery is 0/64 from positives, 2/64 with perfect negatives, and 6/64 with exact occupied-node arrival times
complete idealized A+B+M state evidence identifies 32/64 parameter worlds; the remaining ambiguity is inactive movement-parameter aliasing
targeted P and H interventions split all 16 passive alias classes and make all 64 frozen parameter worlds injective
exact minimum separating design is the two interventions P barrier challenge + H long-corridor challenge
the planner generalizes beyond BAM, fails closed when the evidence library is insufficient, and replans exactly after world contraction
finite nondetection under p<1 changes likelihood but never exact possibility; false-positive observation worlds also remove hard-positive exclusion
at target r1c3, perfect detection leaves 48/64 ecological worlds while admitting p=0.75 resurrects all 16 target-present worlds to 64/64; p=1 calibration restores 48 without a new focal observation
repeat surveys robustly split 0/3 active joint-hypothesis pairs; direct calibration and direct state assay split 2/3 each; minimum worst-case robust nonadaptive set has size 2

minimum worst-case adaptive depth is 2, repeat-first depth is 3, known truth absent::p1 resolves in one calibration action, and removing either direct channel makes worst-case exact resolution impossible

strongest_supported_claim: EOG is best treated as a finite-world falsification and evidence-design framework: observations eliminate only worlds they contain valid witnesses against; unresolved worlds remain explicit; targeted calibration or intervention can be selected to activate differences among survivors.
refuted_or_rejected_claims: Enough positive occurrences generally recover the true generating process.
A complete realised distribution map uniquely identifies the BAM decomposition.
Complete passive A/B/M state observation necessarily identifies generating parameter values.
More finite nondetections can substitute for detection calibration when imperfect detection remains admissible.
A C++ rewrite is currently necessary for the frozen simulation workload.
product_boundary: Finite declared ecological and observation world universes only.
Surviving worlds are compatible explanations, not certified historical truth.
Hard falsification requires zero compatibility across all admissible observation worlds.
Evidence/intervention libraries must be declared before outcome-dependent selection.
If a library cannot separate survivors, return unresolved rather than inventing post hoc evidence.
